name: bash
arguments:
{"command":"python - <<'PY'
import ast
from pathlib import Path
from src.component import count_beautiful_integers

for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(Path('tests.py').read_text())):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Assert):
        call = node.test.left
        args = [ast.literal_eval(arg) for arg in call.args]
        expected = ast.literal_eval(node.test.comparators[0])
        actual = count_beautiful_integers(*args)
        print(f'{args}: actual={actual}, expected={expected}, match={actual == expected}')
PY"}
